recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source edit is needed unless Pharmacy later changes the DosageDetails model or requests a new editorial consolidation of the already-present dose/rate guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-5517 was a Published Pharmacy change request, resolved Persuasive, asking to clarify the relationship between quantity and rate in MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationPrescription, and MedicationStatement, including what happens when rate is not continuous.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly names FHIR-5517. The issue was created on 2015-01-19 and appears to have been applied by the 2015-01-20 pharmacy ballot update commit abce09d8c1, which added relevant quantity/rate guidance to MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationPrescription, and MedicationStatement spreadsheets. FHIR-5516 is an accidental duplicate resolved Not Persuasive/No Change.
additional_context: MedicationPrescription has since become MedicationRequest, and source/fhir.ini keeps MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement in the active build. Later refactors moved the prescription/dispense/statement dosage details into reusable Dosage and then DosageDetails. The combined branch already contains source-fix reconciliations for FHIR-8502 and FHIR-7737, which align related rate-change and titration guidance with the current DosageDetails model.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. MedicationAdministration.dosage.dose and .rate[x] already describe non-instantaneous administrations, distinct events for changing rates, and avoiding average-rate representation. Dosage and DosageDetails already explain rate-derived duration, total dose over scheduled time, changing rates through the containing dosage structure, rendered instructions, and step components. MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement are aligned through DosageDetails.

related_jiras.note: Accidental duplicate of the same request, resolved Not Persuasive/No Change and not independently decided.
Later published rate-change clarification for MedicationAdministration/MedicationOrder/MedicationDispense; already represented on the combined branch.
Later published MedicationPrescription/MedicationRequest titration guidance; already represented on the combined branch and aligned with DosageDetails.
